description: We’re MCP Mission Control, building at the intersection of space storytelling, live community engagement, and AI agents. For NASA’s “Abandoned but not Forgotten,” we’re creating a Mission Hub that turns discarded Moon/Mars hardware into living, interactive stories via an MCP server consumable by web and AI/MCP clients. Users can explore AI-narrated artifacts, ask real-time questions, join moderated discussions, and view live data cards. Join us to build a real, shippable product.
